content.short: Reflexer is a platform where anyone can use their crypto collateral to mint stablecoins.
content.description: Reflexer is a platform where anyone can use their crypto collateral to mint stablecoins. It provides liquidation protection and self-paying loans within a DeFi environment built around RAI, an ETH-backed stable asset. Developers can leverage the GEB framework to interact with Reflexer smart contracts and build integrations on top of the protocol. The project is available across Ethereum and other networks, including Multichain, Arbitrum, Solana, and Polygon, enabling collateral-backed stablecoin minting across multiple ecosystems.
